+import os
+from typing import List
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_API_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/embeddings"
+OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL = "text-embedding-3-small"
+
+
+def _embed(inputs: List[str]) -> List[List[float]]:
+    api_key = os.environ["OPENAI_API_KEY"]
+    response = requests.post(
+        OPENAI_API_URL,
+        headers={
+            "Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}",
+            "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        },
+        json={"model": OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL, "input": inputs},
+        timeout=30,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    payload = response.json()
+    return [item["embedding"] for item in sorted(payload["data"], key=lambda x: x["index"])]
+
+
+def embed_query_and_documents(query: str, documents: List[str]) -> dict:
+    vectors = _embed([query, *documents])
+    return {"query_embedding": vectors[0], "document_embeddings": vectors[1:]}
+
*** End Patch

*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: similarity_score.py
+import math
+import os
+from typing import List
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_EMBEDDINGS_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/embeddings"
+OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL = "text-embedding-3-small"
+
+
+def _cosine_similarity(a: List[float], b: List[float]) -> float:
+    if len(a) != len(b):
+        raise ValueError("Vectors must have the same length")
+    dot = sum(x * y for x, y in zip(a, b))
+    norm_a = math.sqrt(sum(x * x for x in a))
+    norm_b = math.sqrt(sum(y * y for y in b))
+    if norm_a == 0.0 or norm_b == 0.0:
+        raise ValueError("Vectors must be non-zero")
+    return dot / (norm_a * norm_b)
+
+
+def _embed_text(text: str) -> List[float]:
+    api_key = os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise EnvironmentError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+
+    response = requests.post(
+        OPENAI_EMBEDDINGS_URL,
+        headers={
+            "Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}",
+            "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        },
+        json={"model": OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL, "input": text},
+        timeout=30,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    payload = response.json()
+    return payload["data"][0]["embedding"]
+
+
+def similarity_score(text_a: str, text_b: str) -> float:
+    embedding_a = _embed_text(text_a)
+    embedding_b = _embed_text(text_b)
+    return _cosine_similarity(embedding_a, embedding_b)
*** End Patch

*** Add File: embed_batch.py
+import os
+import sys
+from typing import List
+
+from openai import OpenAI
+
+
+def read_texts() -> List[str]:
+    if len(sys.argv) > 1:
+        return sys.argv[1:]
+    data = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
+    return [line for line in data if line.strip()]
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    texts = read_texts()
+    if not texts:
+        return 1
+    client = OpenAI(api_key=os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY"))
+    response = client.embeddings.create(model="text-embedding-3-small", input=texts)
+    for item in response.data:
+        print(item.index, item.embedding)
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())
*** End Patch
